Messages.Author: Robert Ekvall
Messages.Body:
Blood Brother Ambush
Action Modifier/Ally
Clan: Brujah Antitribu
Cost: 2 blood
Put this card in play when an action is blocked. Combat does not occur.
This card is then considered to be an ally with 3 life and 2R damage;
this ally enters combat with the blocking minion. Blood Brothers may
play cards requiring basic Potence as a vampire with a capacity of 3.
Any cost in blood is paid with life. If a card would give them blood,
give them life instead. Burn this card at the end of combat or if the
combat is canceled.
Artist: Ted Naifeh
Rarity: Rare

The blood brothers have 0 hand damage, just as allies have by default,
right?

If a blood brother strikes with for example burning wrath, does he die
before dealing damage to his opponent or does he die in the strike
resolution phase?

Robert

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Robert Ekvall <rek...@hem.passagen.se> wrote:
> Blood Brother Ambush - Action Modifier - Clan: Brujah Anti - Cost: 2 blood

> Put this card in play when an action is blocked. Combat does not occur.
> This card is then considered to be an ally with 3 life and 2R damage;
> this ally enters combat with the blocking minion. Blood Brothers may
> play cards requiring basic Potence as a vampire with a capacity of 3.
> Any cost in blood is paid with life. If a card would give them blood,
> give them life instead. Burn this card at the end of combat or if the
> combat is canceled.
>

> The blood brothers have 0 hand damage, just as allies have by default,
> right?

Correct.

> If a blood brother strikes with for example burning wrath, does he die
> before dealing damage to his opponent or does he die in the strike
> resolution phase?

He dies when he loses his last life, which in this case is when the strike
is announced (long before strike resolution).
